<function name="ViewModelIndex" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the index of this view model, it can be used to identify which one of the player's view models this entity is.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">View model index, ranges from 0 to 2, nil if the entity is not a view model</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
